name: Hollandaise Sauce
description: Historical recipe from The Whitehouse Cookbook (1887). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: the juice of half a lemon
ingredients.originalText: the juice of half a lemon

ingredients.name: boiling water
ingredients.originalText: half a cupful of boiling water

instructions.text: Beat the butter to a cream
Add the yolks of eggs one by one
Add the lemon juice, pepper and salt, beating all thoroughly
Place the bowl in which is the mixture in a saucepan of boiling water
Beat with an egg-beater until it begins to thicken which will be in about a minute
Add the boiling water, beating all the time
Stir until it begins to thicken like soft custard
Stir a few minutes after taking from the fire
Be careful not to cook it too long

source.author: F.L. Gillette
source.originalInstructions:
1. Beat the butter to a cream
2. Add the yolks of eggs one by one
3. Add the lemon juice, pepper and salt, beating all thoroughly
4. Place the bowl in which is the mixture in a saucepan of boiling water
5. Beat with an egg-beater until it begins to thicken which will be in about a minute
6. Add the boiling water, beating all the time
7. Stir until it begins to thicken like soft custard
8. Stir a few minutes after taking from the fire
9. Be careful not to cook it too long
